meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速开展深度调研,产出带引用、经质检的结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把分散信息整理成有依据的调研结论
copy.tagline_en: Run deep investigations quickly, delivering cited, QA'd conclusions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn scattered information into evidence-backed research conclusions

howto.what: 当你明确要求做研究或深度调查时，Claude 会先自行拆解问题，再组建一支合作研究团队分头搜索各类来源。过程中会用辩论互相质疑发现、运行代码验证有争议的说法，最终交付一份每条结论都有引用或验证依据、并通过质检的研究报告，同时实时记录研究过程。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做研究、深度调查，或说出“ulw-research”“hyperdebate”等指定研究措辞时触发。普通提问不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深挖某公司的产品质量问题。
say.note: Claude 会组织团队彻查并给出带引用的结论。

say.text: 做一次深度研究：比较甲方案和乙方案的优劣。
say.note: 会进入完整研究流程，先确认输出格式。

say.text: hyperdebate：列出支持与反对某观点的证据。
say.note: Claude 会组织辩论式检验并给出辨析结论。

howto.what_en: On a research request, Claude forms a team of cooperating researchers, covers all relevant sources, cross-examines findings via debate, verifies contested claims with code, and delivers a cited, QA'd synthesis with real-time logs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for research, deep investigation, or an ultra-precise investigation, or uses trigger wording such as 'ulw-research' or 'hyperdebate'.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate a company's product-quality issues.
say_en.note: Claude forms a team and returns cited findings.

say_en.text: Do deep research comparing Plan A and Plan B.
say_en.note: The full workflow starts; you first choose the output format.

say_en.text: Hyperdebate: list evidence for and against this policy.
say_en.note: Runs debate-style research with evidence checks.
